ala.text: Sedris, the righteous king of Vithia, was tempted by demons and handed thousands of his people to them in exchange for the power and unlife of a lich.
He massacred his family and advisors in a bloody ritual to continue his consciousness as a lich, and the knights who failed to stop him died or fled, while Vithia was overrun by demons and undead.
The capital became the necropolis Sedraxis, still ruled by Sedris.
When his army massed beside Unx, Sedris stepped from his coach to face Eliza and demanded her minions serve him, but she threatened to burn Unx and his armies, and he withdrew his troops.
